description: This class, UpgradeUtil, provides utility methods for upgrading and accessing database-related information within the OpenMRS system, such as retrieving concept IDs, UUIDs, global properties, and concept set members.

classes.name: UpgradeUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for database upgrades and data retrieval related to concepts, properties, and settings in the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: getConceptIdForUnits
methods.description: Retrieves the concept ID corresponding to a given units string from a properties file located in the application's data directory.

methods.name: getConceptUuid
methods.description: Fetches the UUID of a concept given its ID from the database.

methods.name: getGlobalProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified global property from the database.

methods.name: getMemberSetIds
methods.description: Returns a list of concept IDs that are members of a concept set identified by a UUID.

methods.name: getOrderFrequencyIdForConceptId
methods.description: Fetches the order frequency ID associated with a given concept ID.
